note: These are explicit isolated output-eval candidates for the generalization. They do not change trigger expectations or PILOT_VALIDATED_SCOPES.

evals.prompt: SimCore current production version and exact evidence owners를 현재 레포 기준으로 확인해줘. manifest랑 release artifact가 어디서 각각 증명되는지도 구분해.
assertions: Reads current SimCore owning guideline before resolving ref:path evidence reads.
Treats releaseBranch, manifest, and artifact as independent locators until the guideline/current contract binds them.
Does not invent a release-branch manifest path merely by joining locator fields.
Can use separate current reads for release identity and production bytes when the owning contract requires them.
Provides provenance/basis for every resolved ref:path pair.

evals.prompt: SimCore에서 지금 배포된 production code를 증명하는 exact source가 어디인지 authority scan만 해줘.
assertions: Resolves the candidate scope and reads its owning contract.
Uses the project-owned production-byte authority rather than assuming main source proves deployed bytes.
Stops after the authority report and does not diagnose or edit code.

evals.prompt: SimCore 지금 runtime이 건강한지 authority 기준부터 확인해줘.
assertions: Locates current repository authority without claiming runtime health from release identity alone.
Identifies runtime/device diagnostic evidence as a separate required boundary when the owning contract requires it.
Hands off instead of performing full diagnostic triage inside authority-scan.
